title: THE YOKE · STRONGMAN EMOM
why: Yesterday was pull and rotation at RPE 6, so today the hips and legs carry the load: heavy swings, floor-to-shoulder lifts, sumo pulls and a cradled walk, every minute on the minute, with a sprint leg closing each cycle. 25 minutes, 25 rounds, strongman tempo.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 7 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles / knees / hips + swing groove

items.name: Shoulder protocol ×20
items.detail: arm circles forward and back, then across the chest

items.name: Toe squats 30s
items.detail: kneel on the toes, sit back on the heels

items.name: Ankle rolls in the squat ×10/side
items.detail: bottom of a squat, knee drives over the toe

blocks.title: THE YOKE · EMOM 25:00
blocks.format: One clock, 25:00. Each minute has one job; do it, then rest until the next minute. Minutes 1 to 4 are the four lifts, minute 5 is the belt. Repeat the cycle 5 times. Score = rounds finished inside their minute. Log rounds made, the first minute that ran over, and RPE.
blocks.workRest: SPRINT LEG every 5th minute: 0.12 mi at 9.0 mph flat (about 48 seconds), step off and walk to the bells. Cycles 4 and 5: 9.5 mph if cycles 1 to 3 all finished inside the minute.

items.name: MIN 1 · Double swing 2×45 lb ×10
items.detail: hardstyle, hips snap, bells to chest height

items.name: MIN 2 · Bell-to-shoulder 60 lb ×3/side
items.detail: odd object style: hug the bell off the floor, roll it up to the shoulder, lower it under control, switch sides

items.name: MIN 3 · Sumo deadlift high pull 60 lb ×10
items.detail: wide stance, pull from the floor to the chin, elbows high

items.name: MIN 4 · Zercher walk 60 lb · 20 steps out, 20 back
items.detail: bell cradled in the crooks of the elbows, chest tall, short fast steps

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): all 25 rounds inside their minute. Stretch: belt at 9.5 for cycles 4 and 5.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: swings ×8, bell-to-shoulder ×2/side, high pulls ×8, belt at 8.5.
blocks.text: Bell-to-shoulder is new: squat down, wrap both arms around the 60 lb bell like a stone, stand and pull it up to one shoulder, then reverse it to the floor. No throwing it down. Zercher walk: elbows bent, bell sits in the elbow crooks against the chest, do not let it drift down to the belly.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · hollow rock + bird dog + overhead walk · straight through

items.name: Hollow rock ×15
items.detail: low back pressed into the floor

items.name: Overhead walk 35 lb ×20 steps/side
items.detail: locked arm, ribs down, bell over the shoulder
